column7: An administrator MFA reset set users.mfa_enrolment_required but no gate read it, so with security.require_mfa off (or in its upgrade grace period) a reset user changed the one-time password and kept a password-only account. PendingAccountSetupSteps takes the owed flag on HTTP and gRPC (TestGRPCAccountSetup_MFAResetOwesEnrolment_WithoutRequireMFA in ./server/grpc), and TOTP activation clears it.
